Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the intake call yesterday. As part of our SIG/SOC2 deep-dive we need two artifacts from you: a) the CI approval delegation matrix that shows who can sign releases and the delegation/override rules, and b) a snapshot of secret provisioning/provenance showing which automation created access for the release pipeline used in the last 90 days.

Hi Rachel —

Acknowledged. Attaching a preliminary CI approval delegation matrix (CSV) and a short provenance snapshot PDF that covers the pipeline for the July 15 release. A couple of notes up-front:

- Delegation model: we use role-based delegation in codeowner rules + an approvals service. The matrix shows primary approvers and on-call escalation delegates.
- Provenance: the snapshot ties the ephemeral service account (ci-release-bot) activity to a key rotation event in our KMS on 2028-06-30; long-term records live in our secure audit log (redacted) and in the artifact store.

If Northbridge needs the full audit export (redacted), we can provide a timeboxed archive; that'll take a little time to prepare. For immediate review, the attached artifacts should be sufficient.

Next steps I propose:
1) Jonas and Marissa review the matrix for any missing delegations.
2) I prepare the redacted audit export if FinBank wants deeper lineage.

Posting the attachments and a link to the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/finbank/sdlc/evidence/12345

Thanks,
So-
Soojin Lee
Sr. Manager, Security & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Soojin — quick review notes (inline):

- Delegation matrix: I flagged two entries where the 'override' column was ambiguous (engineering leads vs. release manager). Updated the CSV and re-attached as ci-approval-delegation-matrix-v2.csv.
- Approval flow: our policy requires staged approval for production rollouts (team -> release manager -> security reviewer) unless a 1st-level delegate is used; clarified that in the matrix.
- Secret provenance: the snapshot is good but Northbridge may request the KMS operation IDs. We should offer a redacted export showing operation IDs but not key material.

Marissa, can you confirm the change-window for emergency bypass (we have documented 6-hour window in runbooks)? Will note that in the final package.
